text:
Hannah: Quick alert — Prospect (NovaBank POC) seeing repeated 5xxs during a scripted load test starting 11:10PT. Traffic pattern: sharp ramp to ~320 rps for ~3m, then intermittent spikes. CISO wants RCA + whether this affects security questionnaire answers.

infra-bot: autoscaler: scale request for nova-poc-pool at 11:11:05; +4 nodes. policy=scale_by_util cooldown=60s

Priya: Which status codes and model? Any request IDs?

Hannah: Codes: 502/503, occasional 504. Model: r-instruct-xl-v1 (hosted). Sample reqs: a1f2b3c4, b2c3d4e5. Payloads small but many concurrent.

Tom: Pulling traces. Pattern: frontdoor queue spikes -> backend grpc UNAVAILABLE (14) when worker backlog > threshold -> frontdoor returns 503. New pods are slow to become Ready due to quant kernel JIT + container init. No OOMs.

Ruth: Short-term ops options: (1) tenant-level warm pool (prewarmed GPU), (2) enable tenant fallback to r-instruct-large-quant, (3) lower tenant max_batch to 1, (4) change autoscale to queue-based with shorter cooldown. Which do we prioritize?

Hannah: Sales wants the least-cost change that buys demo stability. CISO also wants an audit bundle and clarification: do logs include prompt content by default? We need exact Q&A for the security questionnaire.

Priya: For privacy: default audit bundles redact prompt text unless the tenant opts in. I'll confirm in writing and attach the bundle link. Immediate plan: enable fallback + set max_batch=1; if they want stronger guarantee, provision a warm instance for demo hour.

infra-bot: apply: tenant(novabank).max_batch=1 -> accepted
infra-bot: apply: tenant(novabank).fallback=r-instruct-large-quant -> accepted

Tom: Applied queue-based scaling for pool (cooldown=30s) for 6h window to help tail latency.

infra-bot: apply: nova-poc-pool.scale_policy=queue_based cooldown=30s duration=6h -> accepted

Hannah: Sales asks for cost for 1 warm GPU for 3h.

Priya: Estimate: ~ $0.60/hr -> ~$1.80 for 3h. We can offer the first hour as courtesy for trials; remainder billed to card on file. Drafting a one-line quote now.

Ruth: Uploaded diagnostic bundle: https://redwood-internal/diag/2690012345 . Bundle contains frontdoor spans, worker logs, model load timestamps, autoscale events. Retention default 30d. If legal requires longer retention we need an SOW.

legal-bot: Note: For retention beyond default we need an approved DPA addendum. Loop in legal@redwood.ai for enterprise requests.

Hannah: Sales wants us to "guarantee zero 5xxs" for the live demo. What's our position?

Priya: We should avoid "zero 5xx" guarantees on hosted trials. Offer options: (A) Dedicated deployment with SLA and warm pools (enterprise contract), or (B) temporary mitigations (warm pool + fallback + queue-based scale + client retries) with high confidence but not a formal SLA. Recommend option A only if they need contractual guarantees.

Tom: As an operational safety tip, ask the customer to run a 2-minute smoke test at demo start time. Also suggest client retry policy: 2 retries with jitter. Snippet:

```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
{
  "model":"r-instruct-xl-v1",
  "max_tokens":128,
  "batch_size":1
}
```

Hannah: I'll update sales and the CISO: include diag link, the privacy note on prompt redaction, and the cost quote. Schedule a 5-min practice run at demo hour.

Priya: I'll prepare the security-answer draft for the questionnaire: where logs live, retention, redaction, who can request extended retention, and the escalation path.

Tom: Monitoring shows 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 0.5% within 8m after changes. Keeping watch.

Hannah: Thanks team. Revert temporary configs after 6h unless sales asks to extend. Closing loop once sales confirms demo plan.
